text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Favorites collection gathers every game you've personally marked as a favorite across all your installed Batocera systems. Unlike the All Games list, this is a hand-picked selection curated by you, letting you quickly jump to the titles you play most or want to keep close at hand. Games are added to this collection by toggling the favorite flag from within EmulationStation, and the list updates automatically as you mark or unmark titles. It's especially useful for large libraries, offering a fast way to bypass browsing entire systems in favor of a personal shortlist.
